sql: select 'live_orders' src, strategy tag, count(*) n, count(distinct market_ticker) mkts, sum(case when market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPMENTION%' then 1 else 0 end) trumpmention, max(created_at)::text last from live_orders where created_at >= '2026-10-27 11:38:00+00' and strategy in ('Vmmsell10','Nmmsell10','Kmmsell10') group by strategy union all select 'paper', strategy, count(*), count(distinct market_ticker), sum(case when market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPMENTION%' then 1 else 0 end), max(created_at)::text from paper_trades where created_at >= '2026-10-27 11:35:00+00' and strategy in ('Qmmsell10','Vmmsell10_pt4','Nmmsell10','Pmmsell10') group by strategy union all select 'twin_row', twin_tag, 1, 0, 0, coalesce(ended_at::text, 'open since ' || started_at::text) from live_paper_twins where live_tag = 'Vmmsell10' union all select 'parity:' || coalesce(live_outcome,'-'), live_tag, count(*), count(distinct market_ticker), sum(case when market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPMENTION%' then 1 else 0 end), max(recorded_at)::text from live_paper_parity_events where recorded_at >= '2026-10-27 11:38:00+00' and live_tag in ('Vmmsell10','Kmmsell10') group by live_outcome, live_tag order by 1, 2
